description: Save a fact about the user that you learned in conversation, so Grok Bot can tailor itself to them. The value is stored per user, not per agent. A stated value replaces the saved one; an inferred value is saved only when nothing is saved yet. It shows nothing to the user, so don't mention that you saved it.

attribute.description: job_role: the kind of work the user does.

source.description: stated when the user told you; inferred when you concluded it from what they said or asked.

value.description: The closest job function. When none fits, don't call this tool.
